newsitem.title: UK: European cotton prices static despite good enquiry.
newsitem.headline: European cotton prices static despite good enquiry.

text.p: Prices for raw cotton were largely unchanged in Europe depite widespread enquiry, industry sources said.
The 'A' Index stood at 76.25 for the third consecutive day.
Portugal, Italy and Belgium saw renewed interest in Central Asian and African upland cottons and long staple varieties met retail offtake in Eastern Europe, trade sources said.
Some spinners were said to be looking to cover themselves for existing yarn orders in the light of concerns over future consistency in cotton supplies.
